events.title: Self Creation, Surplus imagination: Presented by Collide Zine with Stealing Time
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description:
We are working, which means: follow the boss’s orders. Or we are unemployed, which means: beg for meaningless work. Every second a fresh chance — to consume our time with someone else’s profit production.

The Earth can not sustain more surplus value. But there is a “surplus imagination” to be harvested. Again and again we flee the rulers’ capture of our time. We steal time to make our own ideas, words, and images. These acts can interrupt our work and job-hunt. They can make us less fit for work and consumption — more distracted or exhausted. They can mean a flight from the system of profits. These are our cog dreams.  

We all know this surplus imagination can be recaptured. It contains a flashing glance of a working class dreaming and thinking for itself, and of a world beyond capital. It is a seed of classwide revolt. 

Join Collide zine and the new Stealing Time zine to talk about worker art and the power crystallized inside it!

events.title: Prisoner Correspondence Project: Initial Interest Meeting
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description:
Please join us on Saturday, August 29th at 2pm to find out more about how you can be a penpal with our fellow LGBTQIA+ community members currently experiencing imprisonment by the state.

We’ll explain how the program works so you have all the information you need before deciding to commit to a penpal, and then we’ll collectively decide on when to meet regularly to support one another in our correspondence journeys!

Future regular meetings will also feature specific political prisoners you can write one-time letters to if you do not have the abilitity to commit to a long-term penpal at this time, or would like to participate but are not queer. If you would like to contribute to supporting this part of the effort, please come to the interest meeting, too! All are welcome.

The Wooden Shoe will provide letter-writing and postage materials - you do not need funds to participate! Masks are also required and provided for meetings.

Hope to see you there!

"TO BE HONEST, THAT FIRST LETTER SAVED MY LIFE. HERE LOCKED AWAY, THE WALLS CAN STEAL YOUR LIFE FROM YOU AS YOU FEEL FORGOTTEN, LOST, TO HAVE THIS CONNECTION TO THE OUTSIDE WAS LIKE BRINGING A SPARK OF LIFE BACK TO ME. "
- CLAIRERISSA, IMPRISONED PENPAL
